question: Discuss the purpose and form of audit documentation under SA 230, and the requirements for assembling the final audit file and for changes made after assembly.

points.label: Purposes of documentation
points.description: Provides evidence of the basis for the auditor's report and that the audit was planned and performed in accordance with SAs and legal requirements; helps planning, supervision, review and quality control.

points.label: Sufficient to enable an experienced auditor to understand
points.description: Documentation must enable an experienced auditor with no previous connection to the audit to understand the nature, timing and extent of procedures, the results and evidence obtained, and significant matters and judgments.

points.label: Content: identifying characteristics and significant matters
points.description: Record who performed and who reviewed the work and when, the characteristics of items tested, significant matters and conclusions, and discussions with management; any departure from a relevant requirement.

points.label: Assembly of the final audit file
points.description: Complete the assembly of the final audit file on a timely basis after the date of the auditor's report, not more than 60 days.

points.label: Changes after assembly and confidentiality
points.description: After assembly, do not delete or discard documentation before the end of its retention period; if exceptional circumstances require changes, record the specific reasons, when and by whom made and reviewed.
